summary: The maintained approved native build stops after GUIDEs without a fixed bridge from current approved intake and reviewed release to actual local website completion evidence. Add a strict source/context-bound private evidence bridge over canonical workflow/release/verifier paths; retain blockers and keep admission/persistence separate.
rollback: Scoped revert of the new evidence bridge and tests; no migration, runtime adoption, permissions or activation to undo. Retain any immutable private candidate releases and evidence history.
